verdict.rationale: First-party docs say agents can be built with a 'visual workflow builder' for multi-step workflows. They also say agents can be managed from a no-code web dashboard. However, this rests on a single thin line, and the specific story elements are not evidenced. The 'conversation flow' page covers turn-taking, interruptions and timeouts, not branching logic. Missing for 10: documented branching/conditional logic, state or node management, agent-to-agent or human handoffs in the builder, and hands-on corroboration that flows can be built without code.
